description: Provision an Azure Apimanagement Backend via Azure Service Operator. Fields mirror the apimanagement.azure.com/v1api20240501 Backend spec.

azureName.description:
AzureName: The name of the resource in Azure. This is often the same as the name of the resource in Kubernetes but it
doesn't have to be.

rules.description: Rules: The rules for tripping the backend.

items.description: Rule configuration to trip the backend.

acceptRetryAfter.description: AcceptRetryAfter: flag to accept Retry-After header from the backend.

failureCondition.description: FailureCondition: The conditions for tripping the circuit breaker.

count.description: Count: The threshold for opening the circuit.

errorReasons.description: ErrorReasons: The error reasons which are considered as failure.

interval.description: Interval: The interval during which the failures are counted.

percentage.description: Percentage: The threshold for opening the circuit.

statusCodeRanges.description: StatusCodeRanges: The status code ranges which are considered as failure.

items.description: The failure http status code range

max.description: Max: The maximum http status code.

min.description: Min: The minimum http status code.

tripDuration.description: TripDuration: The duration for which the circuit will be tripped.

credentialFrom.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret holding the Azure credential to use for this resource. Rendered as the serviceoperator.azure.com/credential-from annotation. Leave empty to inherit the credential from the namespace, then from the operator's global credential. The resource's subscription and resource group come from spec.owner, not from this field.
credentialFrom.title: Azure credential Secret

certificate.description: Certificate: List of Client Certificate Thumbprints. Will be ignored if certificatesIds are provided.

certificateIds.description: CertificateIds: List of Client Certificate Ids.

operatorSpec.description:
OperatorSpec: The specification for configuring operator behavior. This field is interpreted by the operator and not
passed directly to Azure

configMapExpressions.description: ConfigMapExpressions: configures where to place operator written dynamic ConfigMaps (created with CEL expressions).

items.description:
DestinationExpression is a CEL expression and a destination to store the result in. The destination may
be a secret or a configmap. The value of the expression is stored at the specified location in
the destination.

annotations.description: Annotations is an optional set of annotations to apply to the destination resource.

key.description:
Key is the key in the ConfigMap or Secret being written to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a string
this is required to identify what key to write to. If the CEL expression in Value returns a map[string]string
Key must not be set, instead the keys written will be determined dynamically based on the keys of the resulting
map[string]string.

labels.description: Labels is an optional set of labels to apply to the destination resource.

name.description:
Name is the name of the Kubernetes configmap or secret to write to.
The configmap or secret will be created in the same namespace as the resource.

value.description:
Value is a CEL expression. The CEL expression may return a string or a map[string]string. For more information
on CEL in ASO see https://azure.github.io/azure-service-operator/guide/expressions/

secretExpressions.description: SecretExpressions: configures where to place operator written dynamic secrets (created with CEL expressions).

owner.description:
Owner: The owner of the resource. The owner controls where the resource goes when it is deployed. The owner also
controls the resources lifecycle. When the owner is deleted the resource will also be deleted. Owner is expected to be a
reference to a apimanagement.azure.com/Service resource

name.description: This is the name of the Kubernetes resource to reference.

services.description: Services: The list of backend entities belonging to a pool.

priority.description:
Priority: The priority of the backend entity in the backend pool. Must be between 0 and 100. It can be also null if the
value not specified.

reference.description: Reference: The unique ARM id of the backend entity. The ARM id should refer to an already existing backend entity.

armId.description:
ARMID is a string of the form /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}.
The /resourcegroups/{resourceGroupName} bit is optional as some resources are scoped at the subscription level
ARMID is mutually exclusive with Group, Kind, Namespace and Name.

group.description: Group is the Kubernetes group of the resource.

kind.description: Kind is the Kubernetes kind of the resource.

name.description: Name is the Kubernetes name of the resource.

weight.description:
Weight: The weight of the backend entity in the backend pool. Must be between 0 and 100. It can be also null if the
value not specified.

serviceFabricCluster.description: ServiceFabricCluster: Backend Service Fabric Cluster Properties

clientCertificateId.description: ClientCertificateId: The client certificate id for the management endpoint.

clientCertificatethumbprint.description:
ClientCertificatethumbprint: The client certificate thumbprint for the management endpoint. Will be ignored if
certificatesIds are provided

maxPartitionResolutionRetries.description: MaxPartitionResolutionRetries: Maximum number of retries while attempting resolve the partition.

serverCertificateThumbprints.description: ServerCertificateThumbprints: Thumbprints of certificates cluster management service uses for tls communication

serverX509Names.description: ServerX509Names: Server X509 Certificate Names Collection

issuerCertificateThumbprint.description: IssuerCertificateThumbprint: Thumbprint for the Issuer of the Certificate.

name.description: Name: Common Name of the Certificate.

protocol.description: Protocol: Backend communication protocol. Required when backend type is 'Single'.

password.description: Password: Password to connect to the WebProxy Server

key.description: Key is the key in the Kubernetes secret being referenced

name.description:
Name is the name of the Kubernetes secret being referenced.
The secret must be in the same namespace as the resource

url.description:
Url: WebProxy Server AbsoluteUri property which includes the entire URI stored in the Uri instance, including all
fragments and query strings.

username.description: Username: Username to connect to the WebProxy server

resourceReference.description:
ResourceReference: Management Uri of the Resource in External System. This URL can be the Arm Resource Id of Logic Apps,
Function Apps or API Apps.

kind.description: Kind is the Kubernetes kind of the resource.

name.description: Name is the Kubernetes name of the resource.

validateCertificateChain.description:
ValidateCertificateChain: Flag indicating whether SSL certificate chain validation should be done when using self-signed
certificates for this backend host.

validateCertificateName.description:
ValidateCertificateName: Flag indicating whether SSL certificate name validation should be done when using self-signed
certificates for this backend host.

type.description: Type: Type of the backend. A backend can be either Single or Pool.

url.description: Url: Runtime Url of the Backend. Required when backend type is 'Single'.
